basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home located on High in the hill overlooking Vis Valley. With 1,105 square feet of living space, this residence offers a comfortable and practical layout featuring a ground floor bedroom and bath, this bedroom has endless possibilities with the large extra space. The Common Areas are open bright with views of the Valley, Bay and Hills. the large living room and open kitchen dining area make entertaining easy. The home includes one car garage parking space. The back yard is terraced with endless possibilities or relax on the Deck. McLaren Park located 1/2 mile away offers hiking, entertainment, picnic areas and sports fields and more .   Easy access to the 101 freeway north and south.
